text:
Saltmarsh & Rye, a waterfront restaurant in Port Ellery, opened to the public on 14 March 2019 under founding chef Benedikt Auer, according to municipal records and the establishment's opening-night press preview.

The Port Ellery Harbour District licensing filing, Permit No. HD-2019-0387, lists the premises permit as approved by Marguerite Valcourt, the district's licensing officer. The filing confirms the dining room seats 62 guests.

At the press preview, Mr. Auer was introduced as the chef who established the restaurant and set its kitchen. The opening investment was reported at $1.4 million, a figure given in connection with the launch.

The Continental Record reviewed the licensing document and attended the preview in preparing this report. The restaurant has operated under the permit since its March opening.
